answer_4.quote: Finally, we carry out large-scale human annotations to label candidate data for each task via Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT).
answer_4.guideline: We provide detailed instructions with examples to qualified workers and task them with annotating (1) the plausibility of the changed events generated in §4.2, (2) the plausibility of the plausible/metaphysical inferences produced in §4.3, and (3) the plausibility of the transitions generated in §4.4.
